lines.l: You run through the forest, away from it all
You saw a king but good with your back to the wall
You swim through the tides of the summer cold
You follow the sounds of the waterfall
I fall to the edge and I fall to the floor
I swim in circles in a drift of a mole
It seems I can't remember who I was before
I'm flowing in an ocean that I can't explore
But I can't hang on to the surface
And from the wind of the sunlight inside
My lungs are familiar with water
But I want to sing to the Lord
We'll be right back.
I swallow my emotions and embrace the fall
Exploring through the silence of the shell's core
I'm dreaming through the curtain and I feel it all
But I can't hang on to the surface
Infalling a sight in time
My lungs are filling up with water
But I won't say the truth of all
